Hello everyone, welcome to the productivity tools course.
Today we'll talk about building your own automation workflows with WorkBuddy.
Many people are stuck in repetitive work every day.
For example, compiling weekly reports, summarizing data, and replying to emails.
These tasks share one thing in common.
The rules are clear, but they take a lot of time.
The Skill system of WorkBuddy turns these rules into reusable capabilities.
You only need to describe when it triggers, what the input is, and where the output goes.
Leave the rest of the execution to the agent.
For example, a sales team's weekly report used to take one person two hours.
Now a Skill summarizes it automatically in five minutes.
For cross-border teams, meeting recordings can automatically generate bilingual subtitles.
Overseas teammates can follow along at the same time.
For this lesson, you need to prepare three things.
WorkBuddy installed, an authorized folder, and a description of the process you want to automate.
Ready? Let's begin.
